about_the_game:
Anime Expedition 1 – Himalayan Glacial Landscapes & Mystical Ruins

Embark on your creative journey with the Expedition One set, inspired by the icy peaks and mythical charm of the Himalayas. ❄️🏔️

What can you create with this set?

Design breathtaking scenes such as:

　· Glacial landscapes and dramatic cliffs

　· Expedition camps and snowy Nepalese towns

　· Sacred temples, Buddha-inspired sanctuaries, and fantasy realms of gods

　· Helicopter crash sites, frozen travelers, ancient catacombs

　· And even detailed interiors and frozen wastelands

Features:

◆Handcrafted Pixel Art

All assets are lovingly hand-drawn with a passion for pixel art and mapping.

◆Add life with subtle animations!

Enhance your maps with:

　· Animated crystals

　· Local fog and ring fog effects

　· Drifting clouds

◆Beginner-Friendly!

This is the perfect tileset collection for mapping beginners.

Carefully designed for ease of use and creative flexibility.

________________________________________

Included Content

【Tilesets – 42 Sheets Total】

　· A1 Tiles: 14 sheets (Day & Night)

　· A2 Tiles: 6 sheets (Day & Night)

　· A4 Tiles: 10 sheets (Day & Night)

　· A5 Tiles: 4 sheets (Day & Night)

　· B / C / D / E Tiles: 8 sheets (Day & Night)

【Animation – 44 Sheets】

　· Crystals (23 patterns) – 154×158 px

　· Local Fog (7 patterns) – 154×158 px

　· Ring Fog (6 patterns) – 154×158 px

　· Clouds (8 patterns) – 154×158 px

【Facesets – 5 Sheets】

【Foreground Parallaxes – 5 Sheets】

　· Snow patterns – 816×816 px

● Includes a sample map

________________________________________

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
